_doc: Which GPUs a GRID CONTROL mode releases to simulation. The runtime reads the active mode from GRID CONTROL /api/status and takes the pool from here; SIMLAB_GPU_POOL overrides. The two sim-lab modes are the proposal for GRID CONTROL's mode table (docs/RUNTIME_PHASE3.md section 4).

sim-lab-4.label: Sim Lab 4 (GPUs 0-3 simulation; CAD + tools LLM lanes on 4,5,7; 6 rests)

sim-lab-8.label: Sim Lab 8 (all GPUs simulation; overnight sweeps and surrogate training)

decompiler.label: Decompiler + Sim coexistence (decompiler stack on GPUs 0-3: deep 32B TP=4 + triage + embeddings; simulation keeps 4-7)

batch-overnight.label: existing GRID CONTROL mode; no simulation GPUs unless Aaron assigns some

general-fleet-v2.label: existing GRID CONTROL mode (current); all cards hold vLLM weights

workstation.label: darkness, single RTX PRO 4000 (used when no GRID CONTROL endpoint is configured)
